AmpleCapacity privacy policy
A
AmpleCapacity
Product
Pricing
Contact
Privacy
The app collects nothing about you.
No account, no telemetry, no tracking. Two network calls exist and both are named below.
We do not collect your data
AmpleCapacity has no account, no sign-in and no telemetry. It does not send your file names, paths, folder sizes, scan results or anything else about your Mac to us or to anyone else.
The scan stays on your Mac
File names, paths, sizes, dates and scan summaries are read on your Mac and stay there. They are written only to your own disk, in the app's own storage, so it can show you a previous scan.
The app makes three network calls, and only three
One to check whether a newer version exists. One to validate a licence key when you enter it. One, about once a week, to ask whether your licence key is still valid. It makes no other network call. Fonts are built into the app rather than fetched.
Licence keys
A licence key is checked on your Mac against a key built into the app, so activating works without an internet connection.
The weekly licence check, in full
About once a week the app asks our server whether your key is still good. It sends one thing: a one-way fingerprint of your key. Not the key itself, nothing about your Mac, nothing about your files, no name and no email. We keep the date of the last check and a count of how many have happened, against the key — not against you, and not against an address.
We are telling you the one thing this does reveal: because the app only asks while it is open, the date of the last check tells us roughly when that key was last used. That is the price of being able to switch off a key, and we would rather say it than let you find it.
A key is switched off only when the payment behind it was reversed — a chargeback or a refund. If that happens the app stops clearing files and says so. If it is a mistake, write to us and we will put it back.
If the app cannot reach us it keeps working. It only stops after a fortnight of failed checks, so being offline for a holiday changes nothing.
Buying
Payment is taken by our payment processor. Your name, email address, billing country and payment details are given to them, not to us. We receive your email address so we can answer you if you write to us, and a record that a sale happened. We never see your card.
This website
The site is served by Cloudflare. The one cookie this site can set is one we set deliberately on our own machines, so that our own visiting does not pollute the counts described below. Cloudflare keeps ordinary server logs, which include the IP address of visitors, for their own security purposes.
Counting visits
We count page views on our own server so we know whether anyone is reading this. For each visit we add one to a count of the page, the day, the country Cloudflare tells us the request came from, and the site you followed a link from, if any. That is all. No cookies, no identifier, no script in the page, no IP address stored, nothing shared with anyone else, and no way for us to recognise you or follow you between visits or across sites.
Email
If you write to
hello@amplecapacity.com
we keep that email so we can answer and refer back to it. We do not add you to a mailing list.
The test list
During the private test, which ended on 7 October 2026, we kept the email addresses of people who asked to take part. That list has been deleted, and we no longer collect addresses for testing.
Your rights
Write to
hello@amplecapacity.com
to ask what we hold about you, to correct it, or to have it deleted. Since the app collects nothing, in practice this is your emails to us and your purchase record.

AmpleCapacity terms of service
A
AmpleCapacity
Product
Pricing

Terms of service
What you are buying, and what we promise.
Plain terms for a one-off purchase of a Mac app. Nothing here takes away a right the law gives you.
What you are buying
A licence to use AmpleCapacity on a number of Macs you own: three for the Developer licence, five devices in one household for the Everyday licence. You are not buying the software itself, and the licence is not transferable or resellable.
Who you are buying from
Purchases are taken through a payment processor, which is the seller shown on your receipt. Their own buyer terms apply to the sale itself, and are shown to you at checkout.
The free scan
Scanning and inspecting are free and stay free. They only read your disk. A licence is needed to move anything to the vault.
What the app does to your files
AmpleCapacity moves files to a recovery vault on the same disk. It does not delete them at that moment. You can put them back for seven days, or thirty if a Guardian rule made the move. After that window the vault clears itself and the space is returned. Emptying the vault yourself is permanent.
Your responsibility
You decide what to move. The app explains what each item is and what happens if it goes, but you approve every move. Keep your own backups. We are not able to recover anything once the vault has cleared.
What we do not promise
The app is provided as it is. We do not promise it will find every reclaimable file, that a figure is exact, or that it will suit a particular purpose. Sizes on disk are estimates: shared APFS blocks can make them read high.
Limit of liability
To the extent the law allows, our liability to you for any claim connected with AmpleCapacity is limited to the amount you paid for your licence. We are not liable for lost data, lost work or lost profit. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
Fair use of a licence
Do not share, publish or resell a licence key. If a key is found to be shared widely we may stop it working. We will contact you first.
Changes
We may change these terms for future purchases. The terms you agreed to when you bought continue to apply to that purchase.
Getting in touch
For anything at all, write to
hello@amplecapacity.com
.

AmpleCapacity refund and cancellation policy

AmpleCapacity
Product

Refunds and cancellation
All sales are final.
The scan is free and complete, so you can see what the app will do for you before you pay anything.
All sales are final
AmpleCapacity does not offer refunds. Please use the free scan before you buy: it shows you exactly what the app would clear on your Mac, in full, without payment.
The payment processor may still refund
Payments are taken through a payment processor, which is the seller shown on your receipt. Their buyer terms say refunds are provided at their sole discretion and on a case-by-case basis. That discretion is theirs, not ours, and this policy does not remove it.
Your legal rights are not affected
Where the law of your country gives you a right to cancel an online purchase of digital goods, that right stands regardless of what this page says.
Cancellation
Both licences are a single payment. There is no subscription, nothing recurring, and so nothing to cancel. You are never charged again.
If the app does not work
Write to
hello@amplecapacity.com
before asking for money back. Most problems are a licence key that has not arrived or a permission macOS has not granted, and both are quick to fix.

Customer care
Talk to a person.
hello@amplecapacity.com — for questions, licence keys, billing or anything that has gone wrong.
Email us

. One person reads that address. We aim to answer within two working days.
Before you buy
Ask us anything about what the app does or does not do. The scan is free, so you can also install it and look at your own results before deciding.
Licence keys
Your key arrives in the email receipt for your purchase. If it has not arrived, check the address you used at checkout, then write to us with the date of purchase and we will look it up.
Something went wrong
Tell us what you did, what you expected and what happened. A screenshot helps. Nothing AmpleCapacity moves is deleted straight away, so if a file is missing it is almost certainly in the vault and can be put back.
Billing and payment
Payment is handled by our payment processor. For a charge you do not recognise, or a question about tax on your receipt, write to us and we will take it up with them.
